summary.name: Immersive Translate
summary.one_liner: A bilingual AI translation tool, offered as a browser extension and app, that translates websites, PDFs, video subtitles, online meetings, images and comics side by side with the original.
use_cases: Reading foreign-language web pages with the original text alongside the translation
Translating academic papers and PDFs while keeping layouts
Watching YouTube or Netflix with bilingual subtitles
Translating in-browser text selections or input boxes
Following cross-language Zoom, Google Meet or Teams meetings
summary.what_it_does: The tool adds bilingual website translation that places the translation beside or beneath the original text, with selectable display styles. It translates PDFs, ePub, HTML, TXT, DOCX, Markdown and subtitle files, preserving original formatting and offering OCR for scanned PDFs. It provides real-time subtitle translation for video platforms such as YouTube, Netflix and Prime Video, and real-time translation for Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams meetings. It also translates local and web images and manga or comics, and supports text-selection, hover and input-box translation shortcuts. The page says it integrates over 20 AI translation engines, including ChatGPT, DeepL, DeepSeek and Gemini.
notable: Side-by-side vertical bilingual layout for web pages, which the page says it pioneered
Supports over 20 AI translation engines including ChatGPT, DeepL, DeepSeek and Gemini
Translates PDFs with original layout preserved and OCR for scanned documents
Covers subtitles on 100+ video platforms, plus manga and comic translation
caveats: The page does not state the limits of the free tier or whether paid plans exist
Testimonials on the page are user reviews and were not verified
